rules.name: A STIFF WIND AT THEIR BACKS
rules.text: After you Add [Presence] during Growth, Push up to 1 [Explorer] / [Dahan] from that land. (Let other players know this is due to your Special Rule, so they know you're still in the Spirit Phase and not using a [Fasticon] power.)
rules.turn:
growth S, spirit:special S stiff-wind, >presence-choice S C, is C L
  ~stiff-wind S L
#acc stiff-wind-option : spirit e
stiff-wind S L, at V L, piece:kind V explorer / stiff-wind-option S V
stiff-wind S L, at V L, piece:kind V dahan / stiff-wind-option S V
stiff-wind S L / stiff-wind-option S decline
stiff-wind S L
  ?[rng] V
  !(stiff-wind-option S V)
  ~stiff-wind-choice S L V
stiff-wind-choice S L C, is C V, at V L, ~push S V L
rules.evidence: seed 7: Presence added to l1, then 'push whirl *119 l1' (Explorer); seed 1: added to l2, pushes a Dahan; seeds 2-5: added to empty l3, only 'decline' offered, no push.
rules.notes: 'After you Add Presence during Growth' = `growth S, >presence-choice S C`: matching presence-choice nested inside growth gives 'during Growth', and `>` places the push after the Presence lands. Reuses core's push (and its push-dest domain). Needed a Growth step in BASE-EXT; core's add-presence was not wrapped in anything that says 'Growth'.

base_ext: Growth as its own step of the Spirit Phase (`spirit-phase, …, ~growth S` and `growth S, ~add-presence S`), so Presence added by Growth is distinguishable from Presence added by Powers.
